target.tool: customer-selected supported posting interface; reference data is not posted

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Customers and suppliers require Business Partner/CVI mapping, roles and numbering. FI BSEG may be a cluster table in ECC and therefore cannot be assumed readable by CDS; use the full-row ABAP helper or a verified extraction interface when necessary. Open-at-cutover means posted by cutover and not cleared by cutover, including subsequently cleared items. Separate currencies, debit/credit signs, ledgers and fiscal periods; prevent double-counting subledger openings in G/L balances.
